grammarLesson-foundations-attached-promp.source: Which form ends with the pronoun for ‘him’?
grammarLesson-foundations-attached-promp.text: Bentuk mana yang berakhiran kata ganti untuk ‘dia’ laki-laki?

grammarLesson-foundations-attached-rule.source: Pronouns can attach directly to a preposition, a noun or a verb. Their role depends on the word they attach to.
grammarLesson-foundations-attached-rule.text: Kata ganti dapat langsung melekat pada kata depan, kata benda, atau kata kerja. Fungsinya bergantung pada kata tempatnya melekat.

grammarLesson-foundations-definite-promp.source: Which word refers to a specific book?
grammarLesson-foundations-definite-promp.text: Kata mana yang merujuk pada buku tertentu?

grammarLesson-foundations-definite-rule.source: The prefix al- ({arabic}) makes a noun definite. In English it often corresponds to ‘the’.
grammarLesson-foundations-definite-rule.text: Awalan al- ({arabic}) menunjukkan bahwa kata benda itu merujuk pada sesuatu yang tertentu. Dalam bahasa Inggris, padanannya sering kali ‘the’.

grammarLesson-foundations-demonstratives.source: Demonstratives point to someone or something. Arabic has different forms for distance, gender and number.
grammarLesson-foundations-demonstratives.text: Kata tunjuk menunjuk seseorang atau sesuatu. Bentuknya dalam bahasa Arab berbeda sesuai jarak, gender, dan jumlah.

grammarLesson-foundations-detached-promp.text: Kata ganti mana yang berarti ‘dia’ laki-laki?

grammarLesson-foundations-detached-rule.source: Detached pronouns can stand on their own. In a sentence they can point to the person you are speaking about.
grammarLesson-foundations-detached-rule.text: Kata ganti bebas dapat berdiri sendiri. Dalam kalimat, kata ganti ini dapat merujuk pada orang yang sedang dibicarakan.

grammarLesson-foundations-gender-prompt.text: Kata benda mana yang memiliki tāʾ marbūṭah?

grammarLesson-foundations-gender-rule.source: Many feminine nouns end in tāʾ marbūṭah ({arabic}). Some feminine nouns have no visible feminine ending.
grammarLesson-foundations-gender-rule.text: Banyak kata benda feminin berakhiran tāʾ marbūṭah ({arabic}). Sebagian kata benda feminin tidak memiliki akhiran yang menandai bentuk feminin.

grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-prompt.text: Ungkapan mana yang menghubungkan dua kata benda?

grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-rule.source: An iḍāfah links two nouns. The second noun is genitive, and the first noun takes neither al- nor tanwīn.
grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-rule.text: Susunan iḍāfah menghubungkan dua kata benda. Kata benda kedua berkasus genitif (jarr). Kata benda pertama tidak memakai al- maupun tanwin.

grammarLesson-foundations-number-prompt.text: Bentuk mana yang berarti dua taman?

grammarLesson-foundations-number-rule.source: Arabic has a distinct form for two. A plural can take an ending or change the shape of the word.
grammarLesson-foundations-number-rule.text: Bahasa Arab memiliki bentuk khusus untuk jumlah dua. Bentuk jamak dapat memakai akhiran atau mengubah pola katanya.

grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-p.text: Kata depan mana yang mengawali contoh ini?

grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-r.source: Prepositions show relationships such as ‘from’, ‘in’ and ‘to’. An ordinary noun following a preposition is genitive.
grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-r.text: Kata depan menunjukkan hubungan seperti ‘dari’, ‘di’, dan ‘ke’. Kata benda biasa setelah kata depan berkasus genitif (jarr).

grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-prom.source: Which form is used for ‘those who’ here?
grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-prom.text: Bentuk mana yang berarti ‘orang-orang yang’ dalam contoh ini?

grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-rule.source: A relative pronoun introduces more information about someone or something. Common English equivalents are ‘who’, ‘which’ and ‘that’.
grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-rule.text: Kata ganti relatif mengantar keterangan tambahan tentang seseorang atau sesuatu. Padanannya dalam bahasa Inggris antara lain ‘who’, ‘which’, dan ‘that’.

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-pro.source: What kind of word is qul, ‘say’?
grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-pro.text: Apa jenis kata qul yang berarti ‘katakanlah’?

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-rul.source: Arabic grammar groups words into ism, fiʿl and ḥarf. Pronouns and adjectives also belong to the ism group.
grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-rul.text: Tata bahasa Arab mengelompokkan kata ke dalam ism, fiʿl, dan ḥarf. Kata ganti dan kata sifat juga termasuk dalam kelompok ism.

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-tit.text: Kata benda, kata kerja, dan partikel

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-wor.text: Kata benda dan jenis kata terkait

grammarLesson-roots-command-example-1-no.source: Ihdinā asks for guidance. The nā means ‘us’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-example-1-no.text: Ihdinā adalah permohonan petunjuk. Bagian nā berarti ‘kami’.

grammarLesson-roots-command-example-2-no.source: After fa-, sabbiḥ is the imperative ‘glorify’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-example-2-no.text: Setelah fa-, sabbiḥ adalah bentuk perintah yang berarti ‘bertasbihlah’.

grammarLesson-roots-command-prompt.source: Which form directly tells someone to write?
grammarLesson-roots-command-prompt.text: Bentuk mana yang langsung menyuruh seseorang menulis?

grammarLesson-roots-command-rule.source: The imperative directly addresses someone. Its use can be a command or a request. Compare uktub, ‘write’, with yaktubu, ‘he writes’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-rule.text: Bentuk imperatif langsung ditujukan kepada orang yang diajak bicara. Bentuk ini dapat menyatakan perintah atau permohonan. Bandingkan uktub, ‘tulislah’, dengan yaktubu, ‘dia menulis’.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-1-.source: Faʿala means ‘he did’. The three root letters supply the base pattern.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-1-.text: Faʿala berarti ‘dia telah melakukan’. Tiga huruf akar membentuk pola dasar ini.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-2-.source: ʿAllama means ‘he taught’, sharing the root of ʿalima, ‘he knew’. Notice the doubled lām.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-2-.text: ʿAllama berarti ‘dia mengajarkan’ dan seakar dengan ʿalima, ‘dia mengetahui’. Perhatikan lām yang digandakan.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-3-.source: Qātilū is a plural command to fight. The long ā follows the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-3-.text: Qātilū adalah perintah untuk berperang yang ditujukan kepada beberapa orang. Bunyi ā panjang mengikuti huruf akar pertama.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-4-.source: Aʿṭaynāka means ‘we granted you’. The initial hamzah is part of Form IV.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-4-.text: Aʿṭaynāka berarti ‘Kami telah menganugerahkan kepadamu’. Hamzah di awal merupakan bagian dari Bentuk IV.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-5-.source: Yadhdhakkaru refers to someone taking a reminder to heart. The prefix of Form V is assimilated here.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-5-.text: Yadhdhakkaru menggambarkan orang yang menghayati peringatan. Awalan Bentuk V melebur dengan bunyi berikutnya.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-prompt.source: Which form does ʿallama use in {reference}?
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-prompt.text: Bentuk mana yang digunakan ʿallama dalam {reference}?

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-rule.source: Form I is the basic pattern, with its own vowel variations. Forms II–V add sounds, such as a doubled middle consonant, a long vowel, or a prefix. These changes suggest a sense to look for. Check the word in its āyah.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-rule.text: Bentuk I adalah pola dasar dengan beberapa variasi vokal. Bentuk II–V menambahkan bunyi, misalnya konsonan tengah yang digandakan, vokal panjang, atau awalan. Perubahan ini memberi petunjuk tentang makna. Periksa kata tersebut dalam ayatnya.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-2-mea.source: Often makes an action intensive or causes it
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-2-mea.text: Sering menguatkan atau menyebabkan suatu tindakan

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-3-mea.source: Often directs the action toward another party
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-3-mea.text: Sering mengarahkan tindakan kepada pihak lain

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-4-mea.source: Often causes a change or reaches an object
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-4-mea.text: Sering menyebabkan perubahan atau membuat kata kerja menerima objek

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-5-mea.source: Often shows the subject taking on or undergoing the action
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-5-mea.text: Sering menunjukkan bahwa subjek melakukan atau mengalami tindakan itu

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-1.source: Taẓāharūna describes people supporting one another.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-1.text: Taẓāharūna menggambarkan orang-orang yang saling mendukung.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-2.source: Yanqalib describes someone turning back. Notice the n before the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-2.text: Yanqalib menggambarkan seseorang yang berbalik. Perhatikan n sebelum huruf akar pertama.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-3.source: Taʿtadhirū concerns making excuses. Look for the t after the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-3.text: Taʿtadhirū berkaitan dengan mencari alasan. Perhatikan t setelah huruf akar pertama.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-4.source: Taswaddu describes darkening. Notice the doubled final consonant.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-4.text: Taswaddu menggambarkan sesuatu yang menjadi gelap. Perhatikan konsonan terakhir yang digandakan.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-5.source: Wa-staghfirhu asks the listener to seek His forgiveness. The s and t precede the root.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-5.text: Wa-staghfirhu meminta orang yang diajak bicara untuk memohon ampun kepada-Nya. Bunyi s dan t berada sebelum huruf akar.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-prompt.source: Which form gives the sense ‘seek’ in wa-staghfirhu?
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-prompt.text: Bentuk mana yang memberi makna ‘memohon’ pada wa-staghfirhu?

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-rule.source: Look for added sounds and positions. Form VI often shows mutual action, VII a change the subject undergoes, VIII an action involving the subject, IX a colour or state, and X can express seeking.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-rule.text: Perhatikan bunyi tambahan dan posisinya. Bentuk VI sering menunjukkan tindakan timbal balik. Bentuk VII menunjukkan perubahan yang dialami subjek. Bentuk VIII menunjukkan tindakan yang melibatkan subjek. Bentuk IX menunjukkan warna atau keadaan, sementara Bentuk X dapat bermakna mencari atau memohon.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-2-me.text: Sering menunjukkan perubahan yang dialami subjek

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-3-me.text: Dapat bersifat refleksif atau timbal balik

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-4-me.source: Often a colour or bodily state
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-4-me.text: Sering menunjukkan warna atau keadaan tubuh

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-1-not.source: Takbīran names the action urged by the command wa-kabbirhu.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-1-not.text: Takbīran menamai tindakan yang diminta oleh perintah wa-kabbirhu.

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-2-not.source: Taklīman is a verbal noun from the same root as kallama, ‘spoke’.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-2-not.text: Taklīman adalah kata benda verbal dari akar yang sama dengan kallama, ‘berbicara’.

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-prompt.source: Which word names the action of magnifying?
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-prompt.text: Kata mana yang menamai tindakan mengagungkan?

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-rule.source: A maṣdar names the action itself. It behaves like a noun. Form II often uses the tafʿīl pattern for its verbal noun.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-rule.text: Maṣdar menamai suatu tindakan. Fungsinya seperti kata benda. Bentuk II sering memakai pola tafʿīl sebagai kata benda verbalnya.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-1-n.source: Lā negates the worship in aʿbudu.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-1-n.text: Lā meniadakan tindakan menyembah pada aʿbudu.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-2-n.source: Mā goes with the perfect aghnā, ‘availed’.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-2-n.text: Mā menyertai kata kerja perfektif aghnā, ‘telah memberi manfaat’.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-3-n.source: Lam negates yalid. The imperfect ends in sukūn here.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-3-n.text: Lam meniadakan tindakan pada yalid. Kata kerja imperfektifnya berakhiran sukun di sini.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-4-n.source: Lan denies attaining righteousness. The plural verb tanālū shows the subjunctive by dropping the final n of tanālūna.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-4-n.text: Lan meniadakan tercapainya kebajikan. Bentuk jamak tanālū menjadi subjungtif dengan hilangnya n terakhir dari tanālūna.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-prompt.source: Which particle introduces the future negation in {reference}?
grammarLesson-roots-negation-prompt.text: Partikel mana yang meniadakan sesuatu di masa depan dalam {reference}?

grammarLesson-roots-negation-rule.source: Look at the verb after a negative particle. Here lā negates a present action and mā negates a past action. Lam uses an imperfect verb to deny a past action. Lan puts an imperfect verb into the subjunctive to deny a future outcome.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-rule.text: Perhatikan kata kerja setelah partikel penyangkalan. Di sini, lā meniadakan tindakan masa kini dan mā meniadakan tindakan masa lampau. Lam memakai kata kerja imperfektif untuk meniadakan tindakan masa lampau. Lan menjadikan kata kerja imperfektif berbentuk subjungtif untuk meniadakan hasil di masa depan.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-1-mean.text: Tidak, pada tindakan masa kini dalam contoh ini

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-2-mean.text: Tidak, pada tindakan masa lampau dalam contoh ini

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-3-mean.text: Tidak pada masa lampau, dengan bentuk imperfektif jusif (majzum)

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-4-mean.text: Tidak akan, dengan bentuk imperfektif subjungtif (mansub)

grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.source: Shāniʾaka describes the person who hates you.
Maʾkūl describes something that has been eaten.
grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.text: Maʾkūl menggambarkan sesuatu yang telah dimakan.

grammarLesson-roots-participles-prompt.source: Which word describes something that has been written?
grammarLesson-roots-participles-prompt.text: Kata mana yang menggambarkan sesuatu yang telah ditulis?

grammarLesson-roots-participles-rule.source: An active participle can describe someone who does an action. A passive participle can describe what the action affects. In basic three-letter verbs, fāʿil and mafʿūl are common shapes.
grammarLesson-roots-participles-rule.text: Partisipel aktif dapat menggambarkan orang yang melakukan tindakan. Partisipel pasif dapat menggambarkan apa yang terkena tindakan tersebut. Pada kata kerja dasar dengan tiga huruf akar, fāʿil dan mafʿūl adalah pola yang umum.

grammarLesson-roots-past-example-1-note.source: Faʿala has the same vowel shape as kataba.
grammarLesson-roots-past-example-1-note.text: Faʿala memiliki pola vokal yang sama dengan kataba.

grammarLesson-roots-past-example-2-note.source: The nā in aʿṭaynāka is the subject, ‘we’. The ka is the person addressed.
grammarLesson-roots-past-example-2-note.text: Bagian nā dalam aʿṭaynāka merupakan subjek, ‘Kami’. Bagian ka adalah orang yang diajak bicara.

grammarLesson-roots-past-prompt.text: Kata kerja mana yang berarti ‘kami telah menulis’?

grammarLesson-roots-past-rule.source: The perfect verb generally presents an action as complete. Its endings can show who did it. In the k-t-b family, kataba means ‘he wrote’ and katabnā means ‘we wrote’.
grammarLesson-roots-past-rule.text: Kata kerja perfektif umumnya menunjukkan tindakan yang telah selesai. Akhirannya dapat menunjukkan siapa pelakunya. Dalam keluarga k-t-b, kataba berarti ‘dia telah menulis’, sedangkan katabnā berarti ‘kami telah menulis’.

grammarLesson-roots-present-example-1-no.source: Naʿbudu begins with na-, the prefix for ‘we’.
grammarLesson-roots-present-example-1-no.text: Naʿbudu diawali na-, awalan yang berarti ‘kami’.

grammarLesson-roots-present-example-2-no.source: Nastaʿīnu also begins with na-. The rest of the verb uses a different pattern.
grammarLesson-roots-present-example-2-no.text: Nastaʿīnu juga diawali na-. Bagian lain dari kata kerja ini memakai pola yang berbeda.

grammarLesson-roots-present-prompt.source: Which verb begins with the same ‘we’ prefix as naʿbudu?
grammarLesson-roots-present-prompt.text: Kata kerja mana yang diawali dengan awalan ‘kami’ yang sama seperti naʿbudu?

grammarLesson-roots-present-rule.source: The imperfect verb takes a prefix that helps identify who acts. It can describe what someone does, is doing, or will do, depending on context.
grammarLesson-roots-present-rule.text: Kata kerja imperfektif memakai awalan yang membantu mengenali pelakunya. Kata ini dapat menggambarkan tindakan yang biasa dilakukan, sedang dilakukan, atau akan dilakukan, sesuai konteks.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: Allāhu is the topic here. Notice the final u vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Allāhu adalah pokok kalimat di sini. Perhatikan vokal u di akhir.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: Al-kawthara is what was given. Notice the final a vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Al-kawthara adalah sesuatu yang diberikan. Perhatikan vokal a di akhir.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: The preposition bi- makes rabbi genitive. Notice the final i vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Kata depan bi- membuat rabbi berkasus genitif. Perhatikan vokal i di akhir.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-prom.source: Which case does al-kawthara have in {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-rule.source: Case marks show the role of a noun. In many singular nouns, the usual vowel for rafʿ is ḍammah, for naṣb it is fatḥah, and for jarr it is kasrah. Read the ending as you connect the words.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-rule.text: Tanda kasus menunjukkan peran kata benda. Pada banyak kata benda tunggal, tanda yang umum adalah dammah untuk rafʿ, fathah untuk naṣb, dan kasrah untuk jarr. Baca akhiran saat menyambung kata-katanya.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: The condition describes doing even an atom’s weight of good.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Syaratnya menyebut perbuatan baik, meski hanya seberat zarah.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: The person will see that good. The attached hu points back to it.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Orang itu akan melihat kebaikan tersebut. Kata ganti hu yang melekat merujuk kembali pada kebaikan itu.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: Which word introduces the condition in {reference}?
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Kata mana yang mengawali syarat dalam {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: A conditional sentence connects a condition and its result. In this āyah, man introduces the condition. The last word gives the result.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Kalimat bersyarat menghubungkan syarat dan akibatnya. Dalam ayat ini, man mengawali syarat. Kata terakhir menyatakan akibatnya.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-comme.source: Ibn Kathīr explains al-Kawthar as the great abundance of good that Allah granted the Prophet. He includes the river in Paradise among those gifts.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-comme.text: Ibnu Katsir menjelaskan al-Kawthar sebagai kebaikan yang berlimpah yang Allah anugerahkan kepada Nabi. Ia menyebut sungai di surga sebagai salah satu anugerah itu.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-examp.source: Aʿṭaynāka names the act of giving and who received it. Al-kawthara names the gift.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-examp.text: Aʿṭaynāka menyatakan tindakan memberi dan siapa yang menerimanya. Al-kawthara menyebut anugerah yang diberikan.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-promp.source: Which word names the gift in Ibn Kathīr’s explanation?
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-promp.text: Kata mana yang menyebut anugerah itu dalam penjelasan Ibnu Katsir?

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-rule.source: Find what was given in {reference}. Then read how Ibn Kathīr explains that gift.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-rule.text: Temukan apa yang diberikan dalam {reference}. Kemudian baca penjelasan Ibnu Katsir tentang anugerah itu.

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.source: Allāhu is the topic. Al-ṣamadu tells us about Him.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.text: Allāhu adalah pokok kalimatnya. Al-ṣamadu menerangkan tentang-Nya.

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.source: Aʿṭaynāka contains the verb ‘gave’ and the attached subject nā, ‘we’.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.text: Aʿṭaynāka mengandung kata kerja ‘telah memberi’ dan subjek terikat nā, ‘Kami’.

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-pr.source: What role does al-ṣamadu have in {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ru.source: A basic nominal sentence pairs a topic with a predicate. A verbal clause pairs a verb with the subject that does the action. The subject can be part of the verb itself.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ru.text: Kalimat nominal dasar memasangkan pokok kalimat dengan predikat. Klausa verbal memasangkan kata kerja dengan subjek yang melakukan tindakan. Subjek dapat menjadi bagian dari kata kerja itu sendiri.

guideAudioNote.text: Dengarkan tilawah yang tersimpan di perangkat ini. Unduh paket surah untuk berlatih secara luring.

guideBowDetail.source: Bow and pause until you are steady.
guideBowDetail.text: Rukuklah, lalu diam sejenak hingga tubuh tenang.

guideEidDetail.source: Eid prayer has two rakʿāt and includes extra takbīrs. Scholars differ on how many and when to say them. Follow your imam.
guideEidDetail.text: Salat Id terdiri dari dua rakaat dan ada takbir tambahan. Ulama berbeda pendapat tentang jumlah takbir dan kapan takbir diucapkan. Ikuti imam Anda.

guideHanafiSahwDetail.source: When sajdah sahw is due, the Hanafi method is to give one salām to the right after the final tashahhud. Make two prostrations, then repeat the tashahhud, ṣalawāt and duʿāʾ before closing with salām. Scholars differ.
guideHanafiSahwDetail.text: Jika sujud sahwi diperlukan, cara mazhab Hanafi adalah mengucapkan satu salam ke kanan setelah tasyahud akhir. Lakukan dua sujud, lalu ulangi tasyahud, salawat, dan doa sebelum menutup salat dengan salam. Ulama berbeda pendapat.

guideJanazahDetail.source: The funeral prayer is prayed standing. This narration records four takbīrs. Follow your imam and make duʿāʾ for the deceased.
guideJanazahDetail.text: Salat jenazah dilakukan sambil berdiri. Riwayat ini menyebut empat takbir. Ikuti imam Anda dan doakan jenazah.

guideJumuahIntro.source: The Friday prayer has two Fard rakʿāt after the khutbah. Follow your imam in congregation.
guideJumuahIntro.text: Salat Jumat terdiri dari dua rakaat fardu setelah khutbah. Ikuti imam saat salat berjemaah.

guideJumuahRecitation.source: Follow the imam during the recitation.

guideLostCountHelp.source: Unsure if it was 3 or 4? Sahih Muslim describes building on what you’re sure of and making two prostrations before salām. Scholars differ on how to apply this guidance.
guideLostCountHelp.text: Ragu apakah sudah tiga atau empat rakaat? Sahih Muslim menjelaskan agar berpegang pada hitungan yang diyakini dan melakukan dua sujud sebelum salam. Ulama berbeda pendapat tentang cara menerapkan panduan ini.

guideLostDesktopHelp.source: Sahih Muslim describes building on the lower number when you are unsure, then making two prostrations before salām. Scholars differ on how to apply this.
guideLostDesktopHelp.text: Sahih Muslim menjelaskan agar mengambil hitungan yang lebih kecil ketika ragu, lalu melakukan dua sujud sebelum salam. Ulama berbeda pendapat tentang penerapannya.

guideProstrateDetail.source: Make two prostrations with a short sitting between them.
guideProstrateDetail.text: Lakukan dua sujud dengan duduk sejenak di antaranya.

guideSilentRakah.text: Baca dengan lirih pada rakaat ini

guideStartStanding.source: Make your intention, then raise your hands.
guideStartStanding.text: Niatkan salat, lalu angkat kedua tangan.

guideStepHeading.text: Panduan {count, number} rakaat fardu, satu per satu

guideWitrDetail.source: The Hanafi outline includes three rakʿāt of Witr after Isha. This narration records a supplication for Witr. Scholars differ on the form and timing of qunūt.
guideWitrDetail.text: Panduan Hanafi mencantumkan tiga rakaat witir setelah Isya. Riwayat ini menyebut doa untuk salat witir. Ulama berbeda pendapat tentang bacaan dan waktu qunut.

guideWitrDifference.source: Scholars differ on the status and form of Witr.
guideWitrDifference.text: Ulama berbeda pendapat tentang hukum dan tata cara salat witir.

guideWordByWordIntro.text: Pahami bacaan Anda. Ketuk setiap kata Arab untuk melihat huruf, bunyi, dan artinya.

hifzVirtue-aal-imran-end.source: The Prophet ﷺ recited them on waking for the night prayer.
hifzVirtue-aal-imran-end.text: Nabi ﷺ membaca ayat-ayat ini ketika bangun untuk salat malam.

hifzVirtue-al-kahf-first-10.source: Whoever memorises the first ten āyāt of Al-Kahf is protected from the Dajjāl.
hifzVirtue-al-kahf-first-10.text: Siapa yang menghafal sepuluh ayat pertama Al-Kahfi akan dilindungi dari Dajjal.

hifzVirtue-al-mulk.source: A surah of thirty āyāt that interceded for a man until he was forgiven.
hifzVirtue-al-mulk.text: Surah berisi tiga puluh ayat yang memberi syafaat kepada seorang lelaki hingga ia diampuni.

hifzVirtue-ayat-al-kursi.source: Called the greatest āyah in the Book of Allah.
hifzVirtue-ayat-al-kursi.text: Disebut sebagai ayat paling agung dalam Kitab Allah.

hifzVirtue-baqarah-end.source: Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him.
hifzVirtue-baqarah-end.text: Siapa yang membaca dua ayat ini pada malam hari, keduanya akan mencukupinya.

hifzVirtue-eid-prayer.source: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ in the Eid prayers.
hifzVirtue-eid-prayer.text: Dibaca oleh Nabi ﷺ dalam salat Id.

hifzVirtue-friday-fajr.source: The Prophet ﷺ recited them in Fajr on Fridays.
hifzVirtue-friday-fajr.text: Nabi ﷺ membaca kedua surah ini saat salat Subuh pada hari Jumat.

hifzVirtue-jumuah-prayer.source: Both pairs were recited by the Prophet ﷺ in the Jumuʿah prayer.

returnHopeMeaning.text: Jangan berputus asa dari rahmat Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah mengampuni semua dosa.

source.adult: Whatever happened, you’re here now. Tawbah literally means to return, and the door doesn’t close.
source.maktab: Everyone makes mistakes. “Astaghfirullāh” is how we say sorry to Allah, and He loves to forgive.

text.adult: Apa pun yang terjadi, Anda sudah kembali. Tobat berarti kembali, dan pintunya selalu terbuka.
text.maktab: Semua orang pernah berbuat salah. “Astaghfirullāh” berarti kita memohon ampun kepada Allah. Allah suka mengampuni.

source.adult: Feeling remorse is part of tawbah. The door is still open.
source.maktab: It’s okay to feel sorry. That means your heart is good.

text.adult: Menyesal adalah bagian dari tobat. Pintunya tetap terbuka.
text.maktab: Wajar merasa menyesal. Itu tanda hatimu baik.

source.adult: If someone was wronged, make it right where you can.
source.maktab: If you hurt someone, say sorry to them too.

text.adult: Jika ada orang yang dirugikan, perbaiki semampu Anda.
text.maktab: Kalau kamu menyakiti seseorang, minta maaf juga kepadanya.

source.adult: Intend not to go back. If you slip, return again.
source.maktab: Try your best not to do it again.

text.adult: Niatkan untuk meninggalkannya. Jika terulang, kembali lagi.
text.maktab: Berusahalah sebaik mungkin agar tidak mengulanginya.

sayyidMeaning-1.source: O Allah, You are my Lord.

sayyidMeaning-2.source: You alone are worthy of worship.

sayyidMeaning-3.source: You made me, and I am Your servant.
sayyidMeaning-3.text: Engkau menciptakanku, dan aku adalah hamba-Mu.

sayyidMeaning-4.source: I keep to Your covenant and promise as best I can.
sayyidMeaning-4.text: Aku berpegang pada perjanjian dan janji-Mu semampuku.

sayyidMeaning-5.source: I seek Your protection from the harm of what I’ve done.
sayyidMeaning-5.text: Aku berlindung kepada-Mu dari keburukan yang telah kulakukan.

sayyidMeaning-6.source: I acknowledge Your blessings on me, and I acknowledge my sin.
sayyidMeaning-6.text: Aku mengakui nikmat-Mu kepadaku, dan aku mengakui dosaku.

sayyidMeaning-7.source: Forgive me. You alone forgive sins.
sayyidMeaning-7.text: Ampunilah aku. Hanya Engkau yang mengampuni dosa.

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I drop off my bag?
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana saya bisa menyerahkan tas bagasi?

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-2.source: At this counter. Do you have your boarding pass?
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-2.text: Di konter ini. Apakah Anda membawa kartu naik pesawat?

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-3.source: Yes, the pass is on my phone. Here it is.
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-3.text: Ya, kartunya ada di ponsel saya. Ini dia.

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-4.source: Thank you. Put the bag on the scales.
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-4.text: Terima kasih. Letakkan tasnya di timbangan.

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-1.text: Bolehkah saya menjadwalkan ulang janji temu?

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-2.source: Of course. We have four o'clock tomorrow. Does that work?
speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-2.text: Tentu. Besok ada jadwal pukul empat. Apakah cocok?

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-4.source: I've booked it for you. See you tomorrow.
speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-4.text: Jadwalnya sudah saya pesan untuk Anda. Sampai besok.

speakUnit-a2-appointments-word-1.text: Janji temu atau waktu yang ditetapkan

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-1.source: I'd like to send money to my family, please.
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-1.text: Saya ingin mengirim uang kepada keluarga saya.

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-2.source: Do you have the recipient's account number?
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-2.text: Apakah Anda punya nomor rekening penerima?

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-3.source: Yes, here's the account number. How much is the transfer fee?
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-3.text: Ya, ini nomor rekeningnya. Berapa biaya transfernya?

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-4.source: You'll see the fee on the screen before you confirm.
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-4.text: Biayanya akan terlihat di layar sebelum Anda mengonfirmasi.

speakUnit-a2-clinic-line-3.source: Since last night. The pain is worse today.
speakUnit-a2-clinic-line-3.text: Sejak tadi malam. Hari ini lebih sakit.

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I renew my residence permit?
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana saya bisa memperpanjang izin tinggal?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-2.source: At this window. Have you booked an appointment?
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-2.text: Di loket ini. Apakah Anda sudah membuat janji?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-3.source: Not yet. Could you show me how to book?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-4.source: Of course, you can ask the person at reception.
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-4.text: Tentu, Anda bisa bertanya kepada petugas di meja penerima tamu.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I just moved in here.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Saya baru pindah ke sini.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Welcome. Is your family here with you?
speakUnit-a2-family-line-2.text: Waalaikumussalam. Selamat datang. Apakah keluarga Anda ikut ke sini?

speakUnit-a2-family-line-3.source: Yes, my family is with me. Nice to meet you.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-3.text: Ya, keluarga saya ikut. Senang berkenalan dengan Anda.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-4.source: The pleasure is mine. If you need anything, just let me know.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-4.text: Saya juga senang. Kalau perlu apa-apa, beri tahu saya.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-1.source: I'm feeling a little down today.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-2.source: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk?

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-3.source: Yes. If you have time, let's go for a short walk.
speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-3.text: Ya. Kalau ada waktu, mari kita jalan-jalan sebentar.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-4.source: Of course, I'm here with you.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-word-2.text: Sedih atau kesal, diucapkan oleh pria

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I got your invitation, thank you.
speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Saya sudah menerima undangannya, terima kasih.

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Can you come on Friday?

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-3.source: Yes, I'll come after Maghrib, God willing.
speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-3.text: Ya, saya akan datang setelah Magrib, insyaallah.

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-4.source: You're very welcome. See you Friday.

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-1.source: Excuse me, is there an opening in customer service?
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-1.text: Permisi, apakah ada lowongan di bagian layanan pelanggan?

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-2.source: Yes. Do you have experience in this field?
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-2.text: Ada. Apakah Anda berpengalaman di bidang ini?

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-3.source: Yes, I worked in customer service for two years.
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-3.text: Ya, saya pernah bekerja di layanan pelanggan selama dua tahun.

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-4.text: Bagus. Kirimkan CV Anda kepada kami.

speakUnit-a2-office-line-1.source: Do we have a meeting today?

speakUnit-a2-office-line-2.source: Yes, at ten. Can you bring the report?
speakUnit-a2-office-line-2.text: Ya, pukul sepuluh. Bisa bawa laporannya?

speakUnit-a2-office-line-3.source: Sure. I'll send it to you before the meeting.
speakUnit-a2-office-line-3.text: Tentu. Saya akan mengirimkannya sebelum rapat.

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-1.source: Hello, Sami speaking. Can you hear me clearly?
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-1.text: Halo, saya Sami. Suara saya terdengar jelas?

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-2.source: You're breaking up. Can you call me back in a bit?
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-2.text: Suaranya putus-putus. Bisa telepon saya lagi sebentar nanti?

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-3.source: Sure, I'll call you back in ten minutes.
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-3.text: Tentu, saya telepon balik dalam sepuluh menit.

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-1.source: Hello, is the apartment still available?

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-2.source: Yes, it has two rooms. Do you want to see it today?
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-2.text: Ya, ada dua kamar. Mau melihatnya hari ini?

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-3.source: Yes. After Asr works for me.

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-4.source: Great, I'll see you at the entrance.
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-4.text: Baik, sampai jumpa di pintu masuk.

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-2.source: Here you go. Would you like to order now?

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like rice and chicken with no chilli, please.
speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-3.text: Ya, saya mau nasi dan ayam tanpa cabai.

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-4.source: Of course, I'll tell the kitchen.

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-1.source: It's cloudy today. Do you think it'll rain?
speakUnit-a2-weather-line-1.text: Hari ini mendung. Menurut Anda, akan turun hujan?

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-2.source: Maybe after Maghrib. Are you going out?
speakUnit-a2-weather-line-2.text: Mungkin setelah Magrib. Anda mau keluar?

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-3.source: Yes, but I'll take an umbrella.
speakUnit-a2-weather-line-3.text: Ya, tapi saya akan bawa payung.

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-1.source: Excuse me, how much are these scarves?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-2.source: Forty each. Do you want one or more?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-2.text: Empat puluh per buah. Mau satu atau lebih?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-3.source: I want two. If I take two, can you lower the price?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-3.text: Saya mau dua. Kalau ambil dua, bisa kurang harganya?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-4.source: I can give you both for seventy. Does that work for you?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-4.text: Saya bisa beri dua seharga tujuh puluh. Apakah cocok?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-5.text: Ya, tujuh puluh boleh. Terima kasih.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-1.source: I'd like to return the kettle, please. I bought it yesterday and it doesn't work.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-1.text: Saya ingin mengembalikan ketel ini. Saya membelinya kemarin dan ternyata tidak berfungsi.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-2.source: Could you explain the problem? Does the light come on?
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-2.text: Bisa ceritakan masalahnya? Apakah lampunya menyala?

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-3.source: The light comes on, but the water never gets hot.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-3.text: Lampunya menyala, tetapi airnya tidak panas.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-4.source: I understand. Would you like an exchange or a refund?
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-4.text: Saya mengerti. Mau ditukar atau uangnya dikembalikan?

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-5.source: I'd prefer a refund if possible. Here's the receipt.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-5.text: Kalau bisa, saya ingin uangnya dikembalikan. Ini struknya.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-6.source: Okay. Let me check the receipt.

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-1.source: If you're going to the library, I can explain the way.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-1.text: Kalau Anda mau ke perpustakaan, saya bisa jelaskan jalannya.

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-2.source: Yes, thank you. Where do I start?
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-2.text: Ya, terima kasih. Dari sini lewat mana?

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-3.source: Go straight until you pass the pharmacy, then turn left.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-3.text: Jalan lurus sampai melewati apotek, lalu belok kiri.

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-4.source: After I turn left, which side is the library on?
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-4.text: Setelah belok kiri, perpustakaannya di sebelah mana?

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-5.source: On your right, across from the park. The entrance is by the parking area.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-5.text: Di sebelah kanan Anda, di seberang taman. Pintu masuknya dekat tempat parkir.

speakUnit-b1-directions-word-3.source: In front of or across from

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-1.source: I heard your suggestion that we meet in person every week.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-1.text: Saya dengar usul Anda agar kita bertemu langsung setiap minggu.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-2.source: Yes, so we can talk things through. What do you think?
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-2.text: Ya, supaya kita bisa membahas semuanya. Bagaimana menurut Anda?

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-3.source: I see your point, but some people can't attend every week.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-3.text: Saya paham maksud Anda, tapi ada yang tidak bisa hadir setiap minggu.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-4.source: Okay, do you have another idea that would work for the team?
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-4.text: Baik, apakah ada cara lain yang cocok untuk tim?

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-5.source: We could meet in person once a month and online the other weeks.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-5.text: Kita bisa bertemu langsung sebulan sekali dan secara daring pada minggu lainnya.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-6.source: I think we can agree on that. Let's try it for a month.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-6.text: Sepertinya kita bisa sepakat. Mari kita coba selama sebulan.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-1.source: I just wanted to let you know I'm fasting today, in case you offer me coffee.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-1.text: Saya mau memberi tahu bahwa saya sedang berpuasa hari ini, siapa tahu Anda ingin menawarkan kopi.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-2.source: Thanks for telling me. Can I ask what fasting means to you?
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-2.text: Terima kasih sudah memberi tahu. Boleh saya tanya apa arti puasa bagi Anda?

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-3.source: For me, fasting is worship and a chance to focus on my prayers.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-3.text: Bagi saya, puasa adalah ibadah dan kesempatan untuk lebih fokus pada salat.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-4.source: I understand. Would you like us to schedule the meeting in the afternoon instead of at lunch?
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-4.text: Saya mengerti. Mau rapatnya dijadwalkan sore, bukan saat makan siang?

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-5.source: The afternoon works for me. Thank you for understanding.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-5.text: Sore cocok untuk saya. Terima kasih sudah memahami.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-6.source: You're welcome. Let's pick a time that works for both of us.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-6.text: Sama-sama. Mari kita cari waktu yang cocok bagi kita berdua.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-1.source: I'd like to explain my symptoms. The dizziness has been coming and going for two days.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-1.text: Saya ingin menjelaskan gejala saya. Pusingnya hilang timbul selama dua hari.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-2.source: When does the dizziness get worse? Do you have any other symptoms with it?
speakUnit-b1-health-line-2.text: Kapan pusingnya bertambah parah? Apakah ada gejala lain?

speakUnit-b1-health-line-3.source: It gets worse when I stand up from a chair, and sometimes I feel nauseated.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-3.text: Lebih parah saat saya berdiri dari kursi, dan kadang saya merasa mual.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-4.source: Are you allergic to any medicines, or do you take any regularly?
speakUnit-b1-health-line-4.text: Apakah Anda alergi terhadap obat tertentu atau rutin minum obat?

speakUnit-b1-health-line-5.source: I'm allergic to penicillin. Here's a list of my medicines.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-5.text: Saya alergi terhadap penisilin. Ini daftar obat yang saya minum.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-6.source: Thank you. I'll add the allergy and symptoms to your record.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-6.text: Terima kasih. Saya akan mencatat alergi dan gejala itu pada rekam medis Anda.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-1.source: In the sermon I heard ‘I counsel you to be mindful of Allah.’ I'd like to understand the phrase.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-1.text: Dalam khotbah tadi saya mendengar ‘Aku berpesan kepada kalian agar bertakwa kepada Allah.’ Saya ingin memahami kalimat itu.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-2.source: Start with the word ūṣīkum. What do you understand from it?
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-2.text: Mulai dari kata ūṣīkum. Apa yang Anda tangkap dari kata itu?

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-3.source: I understand that the speaker is offering advice to the people listening.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-3.text: Saya paham bahwa pembicara sedang memberi nasihat kepada para pendengar.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-4.source: Right. And what does ‘ammā baʿd’ signal in the sermon?
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-4.text: Betul. Dan apa yang ditandai oleh ‘ammā baʿd’ dalam khotbah?

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-5.source: It signals a shift from the introduction to the subject of the sermon.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-5.text: Itu menandai peralihan dari pembukaan ke pokok khotbah.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-6.source: Exactly. When you hear it, listen for the topic that follows.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-6.text: Tepat. Saat mendengarnya, simak topik yang disampaikan setelahnya.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-1.source: Did you see the headline? It says the new station opens on Thursday.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-1.text: Sudah lihat judul beritanya? Katanya stasiun baru dibuka hari Kamis.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-3.source: The article says next Thursday. The headline doesn't give the date.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-3.text: Beritanya menyebut Kamis minggu depan. Tanggalnya tidak tercantum di judul.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-4.source: Okay. Did they give an opening time?

speakUnit-b1-news-line-5.source: They haven't announced the time yet. Let's check before we go.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-5.text: Jamnya belum diumumkan. Mari kita periksa sebelum berangkat.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-6.source: Right. The details matter more than the headline alone.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-6.text: Betul. Isi beritanya lebih penting daripada judul saja.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-1.source: What do you think about ordering vegetables online instead of going to the market?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-1.text: Bagaimana menurut Anda kalau kita pesan sayur secara daring saja?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-2.source: I prefer the market because I can see the vegetables myself. What about you?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-2.text: Saya lebih suka ke pasar karena bisa melihat sayurnya sendiri. Kalau Anda?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-3.source: I think delivery saves time, especially when we're busy.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-3.text: Menurut saya, pesan antar menghemat waktu, terutama saat kita sibuk.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-4.source: True. But how do we know the vegetables are fresh?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-4.text: Betul. Tapi bagaimana kita tahu sayurnya segar?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-5.source: You have a point. Let's try a small order first and see.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-5.text: Ada benarnya. Mari kita coba pesan sedikit dulu dan lihat hasilnya.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-6.source: Good idea. Then we can decide.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-6.text: Ide bagus. Setelah itu kita bisa memutuskan.

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-1.source: Let's plan the meal distribution for Saturday. Are you free in the morning?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-1.text: Mari kita rencanakan pembagian makanan untuk hari Sabtu. Apakah Anda senggang pada pagi hari?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-2.source: I can come after ten. When do you want to start?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-2.text: Saya bisa datang setelah pukul sepuluh. Mau mulai kapan?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-3.source: Let's meet at eleven by the entrance.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-3.text: Mari bertemu pukul sebelas di dekat pintu masuk.

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-4.source: Great. And if the car is late, what should we do?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-4.text: Bagus. Kalau mobilnya terlambat, apa yang harus kita lakukan?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-5.source: We'll start setting up and tell the team if the time changes.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-5.text: Kita mulai menyiapkan tempat dan beri tahu tim kalau waktunya berubah.

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-6.source: Great. I'll send the plan to the group.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-6.text: Bagus. Saya akan mengirim rencananya ke grup.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-1.source: Yesterday I left my bag on the bus. I only noticed after I got off.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-1.text: Kemarin tas saya tertinggal di bus. Saya baru sadar setelah turun.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-2.source: What did you do as soon as you noticed?
speakUnit-b1-story-line-2.text: Apa yang langsung Anda lakukan saat menyadarinya?

speakUnit-b1-story-line-3.source: First I called the company. They wanted to know the bus number.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-3.text: Awalnya saya menelepon perusahaan bus. Mereka menanyakan nomor busnya.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-4.source: Did you manage to find the number? How did the story end?
speakUnit-b1-story-line-4.text: Apakah Anda berhasil menemukan nomornya? Bagaimana akhirnya?

speakUnit-b1-story-line-5.source: I found it on the ticket, and in the end they returned my bag.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-5.text: Saya menemukannya di tiket, dan akhirnya tas saya dikembalikan.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-6.source: Thank God. Good thing you kept the ticket.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-6.text: Alhamdulillah. Untung tiketnya masih Anda simpan.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-1.source: I promised the team I'd send the report today, but we're still missing some figures.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-1.text: Saya berjanji akan mengirim laporan ke tim hari ini, tapi masih ada angka yang belum lengkap.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-2.source: Which part is missing? I might be able to help.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-2.text: Bagian mana yang kurang? Mungkin saya bisa membantu.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-3.source: We're missing the total number of orders. Can you check the table with me?
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-3.text: Jumlah total pesanan belum ada. Bisa bantu saya periksa tabelnya?

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-4.source: Sure. And if we don't finish it today, what do we tell the team?
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-4.text: Tentu. Kalau hari ini belum selesai, apa yang kita sampaikan ke tim?

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-5.source: We'll send what we have and explain when we can finish the rest.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-5.text: Kita kirim yang sudah ada dan jelaskan kapan sisanya bisa selesai.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-6.source: Understood. Let's start with the total.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-6.text: Baik. Mari mulai dari jumlah totalnya.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-1.source: Excuse me, where's the visitor entrance?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana pintu masuk pengunjung?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-2.source: Ahead of you, on the right. See the blue door?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-2.text: Di depan Anda, di sebelah kanan. Kelihatan pintu birunya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Do I go in through that door?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-3.text: Ya, saya lihat. Saya masuk lewat pintu itu?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-1.source: I'd like to eat here. Do you have rice and chicken?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-1.text: Saya mau makan di sini. Ada nasi dan ayam?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-2.source: Yes, we do. Would you like something to drink?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-4.source: Of course. Your food will be here shortly.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. How are you?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. I'm well, praise be to Allah. What's your name?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-2.text: Waalaikumussalam. Alhamdulillah, saya baik. Siapa nama Anda?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-3.source: My name's Sami. Nice to meet you.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-3.text: Nama saya Sami. Senang berkenalan dengan Anda.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-1.source: Excuse me, where's the clinic? My head hurts.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana klinik? Saya sakit kepala.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-2.source: The clinic is on the first floor. Shall I show you where the lift is?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-2.text: Klinik ada di lantai satu. Mau saya tunjukkan letak liftnya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-3.source: Yes, please. I'd like to see the doctor.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-3.text: Ya, tolong. Saya ingin menemui dokter.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-4.source: The lift's here on your left. Hope you feel better soon.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-4.text: Lift di sebelah kiri Anda. Semoga lekas membaik.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-1.source: Excuse me, I'm lost. Can you help me?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-1.text: Permisi, saya tersesat. Bisa bantu saya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-2.source: Of course. Where do you want to go?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-3.source: I want to go to the metro station. Can you show me on the map?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-3.text: Saya mau ke stasiun metro. Bisa tunjukkan di peta?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-4.source: Yes, you're here, and the station is there, next to the market.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-4.text: Ya. Anda di sini, dan stasiunnya di sana, di sebelah pasar.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-word-2.source: Can you help me? (to a man)

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I have a booking under Sami.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Saya punya reservasi atas nama Sami.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Your room is on the second floor. Do you have your passport with you?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-2.text: Waalaikumussalam. Kamar Anda di lantai dua. Apakah Anda membawa paspor?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-3.source: Yes, here's my passport. Where's the lift?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-3.text: Ya, ini paspor saya. Di mana liftnya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-4.source: The lift's on the right, by the stairs.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-4.text: Lift ada di kanan, di dekat tangga.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-1.source: Excuse me, how much is the bill?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-2.text: Lima puluh dirham. Bayar dengan kartu atau tunai?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-3.source: By card, please. I'd like the receipt too.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-3.text: Dengan kartu, ya. Saya juga minta struknya.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-1.source: Excuse me, is there a mosque near here?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-1.text: Permisi, apakah ada masjid di dekat sini?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-2.source: Yes, just past the white building. Do you see it?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-2.text: Ya, tepat setelah gedung putih. Kelihatan gedungnya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Where's the wudu area?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-3.text: Ya, kelihatan. Di mana tempat wudu?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-4.source: On the left, next to the mosque door.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-4.text: Di sebelah kiri, di samping pintu masjid.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-1.source: Is this the date market? I'd like a kilo of dates.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-1.text: Ini pasar kurma? Saya mau beli satu kilo kurma.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-2.source: Yes, welcome. We have these two kinds. Would you like a taste?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-2.text: Ya, selamat datang. Ada dua jenis ini. Mau mencicipi?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-3.source: This one's very sweet. I'd like this kind, please.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-3.text: Yang ini manis sekali. Saya mau jenis ini, ya.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-4.source: Of course. I'll put a kilo in the bag for you.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-4.text: Baik. Saya masukkan satu kilo ke kantong.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-1.source: I'd like a SIM card for my phone.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-1.text: Saya mau beli kartu SIM untuk ponsel saya.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-2.source: Do you want data only, or data and calls?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-2.text: Mau paket data saja, atau data dan telepon?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-3.source: Data only. Do you have a one-week plan?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-3.text: Paket data saja. Ada paket untuk satu minggu?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-4.source: Yes, we do. It works from now.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-1.source: What time do you open tomorrow?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-2.source: We open at nine in the morning. Would you like to come in the morning?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-2.text: Kami buka pukul sembilan pagi. Mau datang pagi?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-3.source: No, I'll come in the afternoon. When do you close?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-3.text: Saya akan datang siang. Tutup pukul berapa?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-4.source: We close at six in the evening.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-1.source: Excuse me, where do I catch the bus to the airport?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana saya bisa naik bus ke bandara?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-2.source: At this stop. It's about a fifteen-minute wait.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-2.text: Di halte ini. Waktu tunggunya sekitar lima belas menit.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-3.source: Okay, I'll wait here. Do I pay when I get on?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-3.text: Baik, saya tunggu di sini. Bayarnya saat naik?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-4.source: Yes, tap your card on the reader by the door.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-4.text: Ya, tempelkan kartu Anda pada alat pembaca di dekat pintu.

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-1.source: I have a problem at work. Who can I speak with?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-1.text: Saya punya masalah di tempat kerja. Dengan siapa saya bisa bicara?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-2.source: You can speak with me. Would you like to make a complaint?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-2.text: Anda bisa bicara dengan saya. Apakah Anda ingin mengajukan keluhan?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-3.source: I'd like to understand the process first. Can we speak somewhere private?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-3.text: Saya ingin memahami prosesnya dulu. Bisa kita bicara di tempat yang lebih tertutup?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-4.source: Yes, we can speak in the office.
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-4.text: Ya, kita bisa bicara di kantor.

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-1.source: Is this the employment contract? Could I have a copy?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-1.text: Apakah ini kontrak kerjanya? Boleh saya minta salinannya?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-2.source: Yes. Would you like to read it now?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-2.text: Ya. Apakah Anda mau membacanya sekarang?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like to read it before I sign. Could you explain this clause?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-3.text: Ya, saya ingin membacanya sebelum menandatangani. Boleh jelaskan pasal ini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-4.source: Of course. Point to the clause you'd like to understand.
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-4.text: Tentu. Tunjukkan pasal yang ingin Anda pahami.

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I'm new here. My name's Sami.
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Saya baru di sini. Nama saya Sami.

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Welcome. Which department do you work in?
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-2.text: Waalaikumussalam. Selamat datang. Anda bekerja di bagian mana?

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-3.source: I work in the stockroom. Where's the staff entrance?
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-3.text: Saya bekerja di gudang. Di mana pintu masuk staf?

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-4.source: Through this door. Come, I'll show you where you'll be working.
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-4.text: Lewat pintu ini. Ayo, saya tunjukkan tempat Anda bekerja.

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-1.source: I'm unsure how to use this equipment.
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-1.text: Saya belum yakin cara menggunakan peralatan ini.

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-2.source: I'm glad you asked. Shall I explain before you start?
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-2.text: Bagus Anda bertanya. Mau saya jelaskan sebelum Anda mulai?

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-3.source: Yes, please. Could you show me the safety instructions?

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-4.source: Of course. We'll read them together before you start work.
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-4.text: Tentu. Kita baca bersama sebelum Anda mulai bekerja.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-1.source: I'd like to apply for the job. I have an appointment today.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-1.text: Saya ingin melamar pekerjaan ini. Saya punya janji hari ini.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-2.source: Yes, come in. Do you have experience in this kind of work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-2.text: Ya, silakan masuk. Apakah Anda punya pengalaman dalam pekerjaan seperti ini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-3.source: Yes, I worked in a stockroom for two years. Here's my CV.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-3.text: Ya, saya pernah bekerja di gudang selama dua tahun. Ini CV saya.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-4.source: Thank you. We'll look it over and get back to you.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-4.text: Terima kasih. Kami akan meninjaunya dan menghubungi Anda lagi.

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-1.source: I'd like to ask for permission. Could I take Thursday off?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-1.text: Saya ingin minta izin. Bolehkah saya cuti hari Kamis?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-2.source: Which day will you be back at work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-2.text: Hari apa Anda akan kembali bekerja?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-3.source: I'll be back Friday. Where do I submit the request?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-3.text: Saya kembali hari Jumat. Ke mana saya harus mengajukan permohonan?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-4.source: Fill in the request and email it to me.
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-4.text: Isi formulir permohonannya lalu kirim ke surel saya.

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-1.source: I worked two extra hours yesterday. Where do I log them?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-1.text: Kemarin saya bekerja dua jam lebih lama. Di mana saya mencatatnya?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-2.source: In the work log. Do you have your start and finish times?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-2.text: Di catatan kerja. Apakah Anda punya catatan jam mulai dan selesai?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-3.source: Yes, I wrote them down here. Can you check the hours with me?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-3.text: Ya, saya sudah mencatatnya di sini. Bisa bantu saya memeriksa jamnya?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-4.source: Yes, bring the log and we'll check it together.
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-4.text: Ya, bawa catatannya dan kita periksa bersama.

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-1.source: Could I have this month's payslip?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-1.text: Boleh saya minta slip gaji bulan ini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-2.source: Yes, here's the payslip. Which amount would you like to check?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-2.text: Ya, ini slip gajinya. Jumlah mana yang ingin Anda periksa?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-3.source: I'd like to check my take-home pay. What does this deduction mean?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-3.text: Saya ingin memeriksa gaji bersih saya. Apa arti potongan ini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-4.source: Let's go through the items one at a time.
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-4.text: Mari kita lihat satu per satu.

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I ask about my rights at work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-1.text: Permisi, di mana saya bisa bertanya tentang hak saya di tempat kerja?

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-2.source: Would you like the number for the office that handles this?
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-2.text: Mau saya beri nomor kantor yang menangani hal ini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-3.source: Yes, please write it down. I'd like to ask if they have an interpreter.
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-3.text: Ya, tolong tuliskan. Saya ingin bertanya apakah ada juru bahasa.

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-4.source: Here's the number. When you call, tell them which language you speak.
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-4.text: Ini nomornya. Saat menelepon, beri tahu mereka bahasa yang Anda gunakan.

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-title.text: Bertanya tentang hak di tempat kerja

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-1.source: What time does my shift start tomorrow?
speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-1.text: Besok saya mulai bekerja pukul berapa?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-2.source: Seven in the morning. Did you get the new schedule?
speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-2.text: Pukul tujuh pagi. Sudah menerima jadwal baru?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-3.source: Not yet. Can you send it to me?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-4.source: Yes, I'll send it to you now.

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-1.source: Excuse me, where is the exit?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-2.source: At the end of the corridor. Do you see the green door?
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-2.text: Di ujung lorong. Apakah Anda melihat pintu hijau?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Do I turn left there?
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-3.text: Ya, saya melihatnya. Saya belok kiri di sana?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-4.source: Yes. After the door, turn left.
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-4.text: Ya. Setelah melewati pintu, belok kiri.

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-2.source: Here you go. What would you like to drink?

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-3.source: I'd like water without ice, please.

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-4.source: Certainly. I'll bring the water now.

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-1.source: Good morning. I'm a new visitor.

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-2.source: Good morning. Do you need any help?
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-2.text: Selamat pagi. Ada yang bisa dibantu?

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-3.source: Yes, please. Where is the reception desk?
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-3.text: Ya, tolong. Di mana meja resepsionis?

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-4.source: The reception desk is in front of you. Welcome.
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-4.text: Meja resepsionis ada di depan Anda. Selamat datang.

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-1.source: I feel unwell. Where can I find a doctor?
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-1.text: Saya merasa kurang sehat. Di mana saya bisa menemui dokter?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-2.source: The clinic is on the first floor. Can you go upstairs?
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-2.text: Klinik ada di lantai satu. Bisakah Anda naik?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-3.source: Yes. Where is the lift, please?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-4.source: The lift is by the entrance. I hope you feel better.
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-4.text: Lift ada di dekat pintu masuk. Semoga lekas membaik.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-1.source: Can you help me? I can't find my phone.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-1.text: Bisa bantu saya? Ponsel saya hilang.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-2.source: Of course. Do you remember where you last saw it?
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-2.text: Tentu. Ingat di mana terakhir melihatnya?

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-3.source: Yes, it was on the table by the entrance.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-3.text: Ya, ponselnya ada di meja dekat pintu masuk.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-4.source: Okay. Let's ask at lost and found.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-4.text: Baik. Mari kita tanya ke bagian barang hilang.

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-1.source: Good evening. I have a reservation at the hotel.
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-1.text: Selamat malam. Saya punya reservasi kamar.

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-2.source: Welcome. Do you have your booking confirmation?
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-2.text: Selamat datang. Apakah Anda membawa konfirmasi reservasi?

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-3.source: Yes, here it is. What's my room number?
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-3.text: Ya, ini. Berapa nomor kamar saya?

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-4.source: Your room number is 105. Here's the key.

speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-2.source: Ten riyals. Would you like one ticket?

speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-3.source: Yes, one ticket. Can I pay by card?
speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-3.text: Ya, satu tiket. Bisa bayar dengan kartu?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. Where is the wudu area?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Di mana tempat wudu?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Beside the mosque. Do you see the blue sign?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-2.text: Waalaikumussalam. Di samping masjid. Apakah Anda melihat papan biru?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Is the entrance under the sign?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-3.text: Ya, saya melihatnya. Pintu masuknya di bawah papan itu?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-4.text: Ya, tepat di bawah papan itu.

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-1.source: I'd like to buy this shirt. Do you have a larger size?
speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-1.text: Saya mau beli kemeja ini. Ada ukuran lebih besar?

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-2.source: Yes. Would you like the same colour?

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-4.source: Here you go. You can pay at the checkout.
speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-4.text: Ini barangnya. Anda bisa bayar di kasir.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-1.source: I'd like a SIM card for my phone, please.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-1.text: Saya ingin membeli kartu SIM untuk ponsel saya.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-2.source: Would you like a package with internet?

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like a package for one week.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-3.text: Ya, saya mau paket untuk satu minggu.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-4.source: This package is valid for seven days.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-4.text: Paket ini berlaku selama tujuh hari.

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-1.source: What time does the office open tomorrow?

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-2.source: It opens at nine. Are you coming in the morning?
speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-2.text: Buka pukul sembilan. Anda akan datang pagi?

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-4.source: Okay. The office is open until noon.
speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-4.text: Baik. Kantor buka sampai tengah hari.

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-1.source: Does this bus go to the station?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-2.source: Yes. Do you have a ticket?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-3.source: Yes, here's my ticket. Can I board now?
speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-3.text: Ya, ini tiket saya. Bisa naik sekarang?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-4.source: Come aboard. We'll reach the station shortly.
speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-4.text: Silakan naik. Kita akan segera sampai di stasiun.

speakUnit-sim-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I’d like a SIM card, please.
speakUnit-sim-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Saya mau beli kartu SIM.

speakUnit-sim-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Do you want an internet package?

speakUnit-sim-line-4.source: Fifty riyals. I need your passport.
speakUnit-sim-line-4.text: Lima puluh riyal. Saya perlu paspor Anda.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-2.source: Of course, I'll bring you a wheelchair. Do you want to go up?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-2.text: Tentu, saya akan bawakan kursi roda. Apakah Anda ingin naik ke atas?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-4.source: Follow the lift sign. I'll come with you.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-4.text: Ikuti papan petunjuk lift. Saya akan ikut menemani.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-2.source: Do you want to go in or get out?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-4.source: Look for the sign that says 'exit'.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-2.source: This way. Do you have a map?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-2.text: Lewat sini. Apakah Anda punya peta?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-4.source: Of course. Look, you're here, and this is the Haram.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-4.text: Tentu. Lihat, Anda ada di sini dan ini Masjidilharam.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-2.source: You're welcome here. Do you have a number for someone in your group?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-2.text: Selamat datang. Apakah Anda punya nomor telepon salah satu anggota rombongan?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-4.source: Of course. Have a seat here while I call them.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-4.text: Tentu. Silakan duduk di sini sementara saya menelepon mereka.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-2.source: We'll replace your key. Do you need anything else?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-2.text: Kami akan mengganti kunci Anda. Ada lagi yang diperlukan?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-4.source: Of course. We'll send them to your room.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-4.text: Tentu. Kami akan mengantarkannya ke kamar Anda.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-2.source: The wudu area is nearby. Are you looking for the prayer area too?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-2.text: Tempat wudunya dekat. Apakah Anda juga sedang mencari tempat salat?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-4.source: This sign points you to the women's prayer area.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-4.text: Papan ini menunjukkan arah ke tempat salat wanita.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-2.source: The station is a little far. Do you want to take a taxi?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-2.text: Stasiunnya agak jauh. Apakah Anda ingin naik taksi?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-4.source: Get in by the taxi sign.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-4.text: Naiklah di dekat papan petunjuk taksi.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-word-1.text: Anda naik atau masuk ke kendaraan

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-2.source: Here by the sign. Would you like a cup?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-2.text: Di sini, dekat papan petunjuk. Mau gelas untuk minum?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-4.source: Here you go. Here's a cup of water.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-line-2.source: This is the way to the Masʿā. Do you also want to know where the Maṭāf is?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-line-2.text: Ini jalan menuju Mas’a. Apakah Anda juga ingin tahu lokasi Mataf?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-title.text: Mencari jalur sai dan area tawaf

speakWorkPackDescription.source: Practise Emirati Arabic for job interviews, shifts, contracts and payslips. Learn to ask about safety and workplace rights.
speakWorkPackDescription.text: Latih bahasa Arab Emirat untuk wawancara kerja, giliran kerja, kontrak, dan slip gaji. Pelajari cara bertanya tentang keselamatan dan hak di tempat kerja.
